name: Skills
description: Agent Skills support. The plugin finds SKILL.md packs in the project, home-shared, and user-agent roots. It exposes them with progressive disclosure. The Level 1 catalog is in the system prompt. The Skill tool loads Level 2/3 on demand.

tool.name: Skill
tool.description: Discover, inspect and load an Agent Skill. A skill is a SKILL.md pack that holds instructions, scripts and references for one task. Discovery scans the skill roots at session start, and a closer root wins. Use it when a task matches a skill description, or when a workflow must be repeatable. Do not use it for a trivial one-off command. Do not paraphrase a skill from its catalog entry, because the catalog is a router. Returns the catalog for `list`, the frontmatter for `info`, and the body plus a sibling list for `read`.

action.description: What to do. Use list to show every discovered skill, with broken and shadowed entries, and no maxSkills cap. Use info to show the frontmatter of one skill, with no body load. Use read to show the full SKILL.md body, a trailer of bundled sibling files, and the declared allowed-tools field.

name.description: Skill name (must match the SKILL.md frontmatter `name` field). Required for 'info' and 'read'.
